user.title: Add a Neatsvor S600
user.description: MAC address of the robot, in the format {format}.

account.title: JoyLife account
account.description: Email of the account used in the JoyLife/Neatsvor app (no password needed). It is used to fetch rooms, maps and voice packs; robot control does not need it.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to JoyLife again
reauth_confirm.description: The JoyLife server refused the stored account. Enter the email used in the JoyLife/Neatsvor app (no password needed). Robot control keeps working in the meantime.

error.invalid_auth: Email refused by the JoyLife server.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the JoyLife server.

not_connected.message: The robot cloud connection is unavailable. Try again in a moment.

command_failed.message: The robot cloud did not accept the command in time.

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Starts a targeted cleaning of one or more rooms. By default (-1) the robot applies the suction/mopping settings saved on the map for each room — this is the validated way. Explicit levels were not honoured by the robot in real tests.

fan_level.name: Suction level
fan_level.description: -1 = use the setting saved on the map (default). An explicit level (1-4) did not change the robot's behaviour in tests.

water_level.name: Mopping level
water_level.description: -1 = use the setting saved on the map (default).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: -1 = use the app default (validated). Other values are unconfirmed.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names (e.g. Kitchen) and/or ids, as shown in the map's rooms attribute. Case and accents are ignored; a unique partial name works.
